name: craftvideo
description: Make or edit video on your own machine. Make a narrated motion-graphics video from a topic (brag's storyboard, any TTS, renderer and editor), or edit a recording professionally (dead air and fillers out, clean levelled audio, captions, vertical reframing that follows the speaker's face, OTIO/EDL hand-off), or cut shorts out of a long recording (a transcript-first shortlist, a rubric for the pick, vertical clips with kinetic captions), with 3D (Three.js, img2threejs models), WebGPU shaders, GSAP, vector animation (SVG scenes, animated SVG files), pixel art that stays pixel-exact (sprite scenes, or any footage), a hand-painted mascot and transparent overlays for both. Swappable, contract-checked providers and measured QA gates.
